name: SOLO-2
published_ref: Pujade-Lauraine et al., Lancet Oncol 2017, PMID 28754483 — Olaparib maintenance vs placebo in BRCA1/2-mut PSR ovarian
why_failed_or_succeeded: BRCA1/2-mutant patients on olaparib maintenance: PFS 19.1 months vs 5.5 months placebo (HR=0.30, p<0.0001). The mechanism is synthetic lethality: BRCA1/2 LOF disables homologous recombination, and PARP trapping at SSBs causes replication fork collapse → DSBs that HR-deficient cells cannot repair → cell death. This is FDA-validated, backed by 7/7 evidence modalities in CrisPRO's SL v4 frozen receipts.

non_responder.label: BRCA-WT, HR-proficient (PARPi non-benefiters in PRIMA/NOVA subgroup analyses)

discriminating_axes: ddr (0.85 vs 0.20) — BRCA-mutant DDR deficiency is the synthetic lethal axis, validated by 7/7 multimodal evidence layers in SL v4 frozen receipts
